title: Finch Circle Loyalty Program — Registrant Tenure Courtesy on Registry Credit Refunds (Merchandise Purchases)
content:
**Tenure courtesy.** On a refund of registry credit left undeducted on a Merchandise Purchases unit, a registrant whose active Finch Circle membership was enrolled at least the long-tenure months of 120 months before the request date (whole months) receives the long registrant tenure courtesy of $12.00; one enrolled at least the middle-tenure months of 60 months but fewer than 120 months receives the middle registrant tenure courtesy of $6.00. A registrant enrolled fewer than 60 whole months before the request date, or with no active membership, is outside this rule.

Tenure is read from the enrollment date of the registrant's active membership in the Finch Circle Loyalty Program records, counted in whole months to the request date.

## Both sides of each threshold (hypothetical request date 10 May)

| Enrollment date | Whole months to 10 May | Courtesy |
|---|---|---|
| 10 May, ten years earlier | 120 | $12.00 |
| 11 May, ten years earlier | 119 | $6.00 |
| 10 May, five years earlier | 60 | $6.00 |
| 11 May, five years earlier | 59 | outside this rule |
